skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain economic growth theories and their application to real-world scenarios.
Apply statistical methods to analyze economic growth data.
Measure and analyze labor capital in economic models.
Analyze factors affecting international technology transfer.
Evaluate the impact of open economies on economic growth.
Understand and analyze the role of government policies in promoting economic growth.
Develop independent research skills using secondary sources and analytical tools.
Work effectively in teams to solve practical problems related to economic growth.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and critique issues related to economic growth.
Develop effective presentation skills to communicate research findings.
Enhance self-learning abilities to continuously improve knowledge on economic growth topics.
